notes: Live Dorna utility fix. STEALTH:AUTO is no longer a permanent slow travel mode: it enters stealth only when a living visible enemy is nearby and exits automatically when no nearby threat exists, so Dorna runs normally to locks/traps. Utility danger is now party-aware (Dorna/master/faction targets and nearby attackers/enemies), not only Dorna/master GetAttackTarget. Trap disarm and lock opening are strictly out-of-combat: combat cancels an already queued DISARM_TRAP/OPEN_LOCK action and utility checks danger before cooldown. Autonomous combat/self-tick 0.8.6.11, target switching, dual-wield behavior/diagnostics, PRC familiar FIX5, Plada progression and protected combat core 0.7.10.7 are otherwise unchanged.
